text: つり　ばっかり　して　ないで　もっと　しごとも　できれば　…と　いいつつ　やめられませんな

structure.jp: つり　ばっかり　して　ないで
structure.en: instead of doing nothing but fishing

structure.jp: もっと　しごとも　できれば
structure.en: if only I could do more work too

patterns.name: 〜ないで
patterns.explanation: ないで after a verb means 'without doing' or 'instead of doing'. して　ないで is a short form of していないで. つり　ばっかり　して　ないで = 'instead of just fishing all the time'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば on a verb means 'if'. Left hanging with nothing after it, it sounds like a wish. しごとも　できれば = 'if only I could do some work too'.

patterns.name: 〜つつ
patterns.explanation: つつ after a verb means 'while doing', and here it has the feel of 'even though'. と　いいつつ = 'even while saying that'.
